newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai serial killer sentenced to death.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai serial killer sentenced to death.

text.p: A man charged with a series of killings and robberies against women that shook Shanghai earlier this year was sentenced to death on Thursday by a local court, the Xinmin Evening News reported.
The court heard that Wei Guangxiu carried out 13 attacks on women using an iron bar between March 18 and April 14, and two women were killed and 12 injured, the newspaper said.
The motive for the attacks was robbery.
It did not say anything about a possible appeal or when the sentence would be carried out.
The case caused a spate of lurid rumours in the city prior to Wei's capture due to a complete lack of information in the official media on the case.
